Page 77 Cont.
John Wilson - 13 - again ( from 9th)
June June 25 Mr. Geo Trabing - 52 - lutheran abcess on lung. Drs say only remedy is operation - Enrolled
Mrs. Anna Ala - 29 - Seemingly "hopeless T.B." in Kiefer's - over a year - has husband and 4 little.
Wm Reynolds - 55 - inward cancer operation feared necessary
Page 78 June 29 Paul D. Corbett - 42 - tendency to enemia ... can not keep warm - has been active till a few yrs. ago.
29
Leo Durkin - 36 - negligent in receiving the holy Sacr.
30 Mrs. Stella Pisarak - 57 - threatened with cataract .... John Reardon - 44 - Lillian - 40 - Serious Operation soon soon - anxious Mrs. Mrs. Ringh - knee - her Mother Schemansky
1943, July July July 7 Mrs. Anna Elsey - 62 - inward cancer
Thanks. . . . Roland MacDougall - 11 - Double pneumonia and Spinal man- ingitis at 10 months of age ... Drs all gave no hopes ... Enrolled in Ser. Masses when a year old ... contrary to "scientific predictions that he'd never walk or talk he does both and goes to school in 3rd grade.
Margaret Leonard - 41 - like asmatic congestion.
Page 79 July 1 1 Mary Jacquelyn Brinkes - 18 - Brain cancer - huge tuomer removed 4th of May ... 6 smaller tuomers removed since ..... Enrolled in Ser. Masses late in January or in Feb ... Drs in Ann Arbor astonished at her vital- ity. Now lumps appear in chest and Drs say "no hopes". Mother pro- mised to do something for her every month till death if she were spared - a high Mass monthly.
